news.detail: Sanders knocked in field goals from 41, 27, 22 and 48 yards out in Sunday's contest. The kicker accounted for all 12 of the Jets' points for a second straight week, performing the same feat in the team's Week 9 loss to the Chiefs. Sanders moves to 25-for-28 on field-goal attempts over nine contests
